name: Intai Jikken ~Rinji Hoken'i no Injoku Kiroku~
original_name: 淫体実験～臨時保健医の淫辱記録～
source:
Micromanage the tight schedules of young girls! 
You are an obsessive compulsive disorder sufferer. 
Get to know the girls you yearn for, under the false guise of body tests. 
Once you've gotten in with them, win over their bodies and hearts. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE067381.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
微观管理年轻女孩紧凑的日程！

你患有强迫症。

以身体检查为幌子，了解那些令你渴望的女孩。

与她们熟悉后，赢得她们的身体与心灵。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE067381.html]DLsite English[/url]）
